   381	/-! ## Local-away generators for the canonical evaluation -/
   382	
   383	/-- Nonvanishing on every residue-field fibre of `D(f)` survives passage from the
   384	corresponding prime of the original ring to the residue field of a prime of `A_f`.
   385	
   386	The residue-field comparison is an isomorphism because localization induces bijective
   387	residue-field maps.  Keeping this as a private module lemma prevents the rank-one
   388	construction from depending on a false definitional transitivity of datum base change. -/
   389	private theorem fibre_tmul_ne_zero_of_away
   390	    {A Q : Type u} [CommRing A] [AddCommGroup Q] [Module A Q]
   391	    (f : A) (y : Q)
   392	    (hy : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum A, f ∉ p.asIdeal →
   393	      (y ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
   394	        Q ⊗[A] p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0)
   395	    (q : PrimeSpectrum (Localization.Away f)) :
   396	    ((1 : q.asIdeal.ResidueField) ⊗ₜ[A] y :
   397	      q.asIdeal.ResidueField ⊗[A] Q) ≠ 0 := by
   398	  let p : PrimeSpectrum A :=
   399	    PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap A (Localization.Away f)) q
   400	  have hfp : f ∉ p.asIdeal := by
   401	    intro hf
   402	    refine q.isPrime.ne_top (Ideal.eq_top_of_isUnit_mem q.asIdeal
   403	      (Ideal.mem_comap.mp hf) ?_)
   404	    exact IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit f
   405	  have hp : ((1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ⊗ₜ[A] y :
   406	      p.asIdeal.ResidueField ⊗[A] Q) ≠ 0 := by
   407	    have h := (TensorProduct.comm A Q p.asIdeal.ResidueField).map_ne_zero_iff.mpr
   408	      (hy p hfp)
   409	    simpa only [TensorProduct.comm_tmul] using h
   410	  have hcom : p.asIdeal =
   411	      q.asIdeal.comap (algebraMap A (Localization.Away f)) := rfl
   412	  let rho : p.asIdeal.ResidueField →ₐ[A] q.asIdeal.ResidueField :=
   413	    Ideal.ResidueField.mapₐ p.asIdeal q.asIdeal
   414	      (Algebra.ofId A (Localization.Away f)) hcom
   415	  have hrho : Function.Bijective rho :=
   416	    (RingHom.surjectiveOnStalks_of_isLocalization (Submonoid.powers f)
   417	      (Localization.Away f)).residueFieldMap_bijective
   418	        p.asIdeal q.asIdeal hcom
   419	  let e : p.asIdeal.ResidueField ≃ₗ[A] q.asIdeal.ResidueField :=
   420	    LinearEquiv.ofBijective rho.toLinearMap hrho

     9	/-!
    10	# The presentation locus for the rank-one Abel map
    11	
    12	`PicRankOneOpen` is the functorial locus in the degree-`genus C` Picard layer whose pullback to
    13	every affine test admits a tied `PicRankOneLocalPresentation`.  Quantifying after every affine
    14	pullback makes the condition intrinsic on arbitrary test schemes; stability under further
    15	pullback is exactly `picEtMap_comp`.
    16	
    17	The remaining declarations form the corresponding preimages in the widened divisor functor and
    18	in its canonical representing Yoneda functor, together with the restricted Abel transformations.
    19	These are logical subfunctors only.  In particular, this file does not assert that
    20	`PicRankOneOpen` is represented by an open subscheme.  The relative-openness acceptance gate and
    21	the conditional universal-divisor carrier contract are exposed separately in `DivRankOneOpen.lean`.
    22	-/
    23	
    24	set_option autoImplicit false
    25	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    26	
    27	universe u
    28	
    29	open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory
    30	
    31	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    32	
    33	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    34	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    35	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    36	variable (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi]
    37	
    38	noncomputable section
    39	
    40	/-- The rank-one presentation locus in the degree-`genus C` Picard layer.
    41	
    42	Membership means that every affine pullback of the input plus class admits a local presentation
    43	tied to that pullback.  This is the correct logical subfunctor underlying the future open Picard
    44	locus; no openness or representability assertion is part of this definition. -/
    45	def PicRankOneOpen :
    46	    Subfunctor (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)) where
    47	  obj T := {lam | ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    48	      (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
    49	    Nonempty (PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi
    50	      ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op lam))}
    51	  map {T T'} f lam hlam A _ _ t := by
    52	    let F := picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)
    53	    have e : F.map t.op (F.map f lam) = F.map (t ≫ f.unop).op lam := by
    54	      apply Subtype.ext
    55	      exact (picEtMap_comp C f.unop t lam.1).symm
    56	    rw [e]
    57	    exact hlam A (t ≫ f.unop)
    58	
    59	/-! ## The public membership contract -/
    60	
    61	/-- The exact producer predicate for the rank-one locus.
    62	
    63	This is intentionally lambda-tied and quantifies over every affine pullback.  In particular, it
    64	is stronger than a field-fibre `h⁰ = 1`/`H¹ = 0` statement: a producer must supply the complete
    65	`PicRankOneLocalPresentation` structure for the pulled-back class. -/
    66	def PicRankOneOpen.LocalPresentationCondition
    67	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
    68	    (lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T) : Prop :=
    69	  ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    70	    (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
    71	    Nonempty (PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi
    72	      ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op lam))
    73	
    74	/-- Unfolded membership in `PicRankOneOpen`, with the presentation tied to the pulled-back
    75	Picard class.  Keeping this predicate named is important for producers in later lanes: a
    76	field-level divisor or chart witness is not a substitute for this arbitrary-affine-pullback
    77	contract. -/
    78	theorem mem_picRankOneOpen_iff {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
    79	    (lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T) :
    80	    lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T ↔
    81	      ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    82	        (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
    83	        Nonempty (PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi
    84	          ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op lam)) := by
    85	  rfl
    86	
    87	/-- Constructor for the exact lambda-tied arbitrary-affine-pullback presentation contract. -/
    88	theorem mem_picRankOneOpen_of_localPresentations
    89	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
    90	    {lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T}
    91	    (h : ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    92	        (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
    93	        Nonempty (PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi
    94	          ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op lam))) :
    95	    lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T :=
    96	  (mem_picRankOneOpen_iff pi lam).mpr h
    97	
    98	/-- Constructor using the named arbitrary-affine producer predicate. -/
    99	theorem mem_picRankOneOpen_of_localPresentationCondition
   100	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
   101	    {lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T}
   102	    (h : PicRankOneOpen.LocalPresentationCondition pi lam) :
   103	    lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T := by
   104	  exact mem_picRankOneOpen_of_localPresentations pi h
   105	
   106	/-- The inclusion of the public rank-one locus into its degree-genus ambient functor. -/
   107	def picRankOneOpenIncl :
   108	    (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor ⟶ picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ) :=
   109	  (PicRankOneOpen pi).ι
   110	
   111	/-- The same inclusion after the slice-to-big-site `Σ` extension.
   112	
   113	`IsOpenImmersion.presheaf` is a property of presheaves on schemes.  The rank-one functor is
   114	defined on the slice over `Spec k`, so the `Σ` extension is the category-correct carrier for the
   115	relative-open gate below. -/
   116	def picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl :
   117	    Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor ⟶
   118	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)) :=
   119	  Over.sigmaExtensionNat (PicRankOneOpen pi).ι
   120	
   121	/-- Relative openness of the public locus, in Mathlib's presheaf sense.
   122	
   123	This is a named acceptance gate rather than an unproved global assertion.  A future geometric
   124	producer discharges it by supplying the represented open pullbacks; no arbitrary `Subfunctor` is
   125	silently treated as an open subscheme. -/
   126	def PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen : Prop :=
   127	  IsOpenImmersion.presheaf (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi)
   128	
   129	/-- Expose a supplied relative-open certificate without hiding it behind typeclass search. -/
   130	theorem picRankOneOpen_isOpen_of_certificate
   131	    (h : PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi) : PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi :=
   132	  h
   133	
   134	/-- Extract the open immersion supplied by the relative-openness certificate on an arbitrary
   135	pullback.  This is the exact shape consumed by an eventual chart/fibre producer. -/
   136	theorem picRankOneOpen_openPullback
   137	    (h : PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi)
   138	    {X Z : Scheme.{u}}
   139	    (g : yoneda.obj X ⟶
   140	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)))
   141	    (fst : yoneda.obj Z ⟶
   142	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor)
   143	    (snd : Z ⟶ X)
   144	    (hpb : IsPullback fst (yoneda.map snd) (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi) g) :
   145	    IsOpenImmersion snd :=
   146	  h.property g fst snd hpb
   147	
   148	/-- Pullback stability of the public rank-one locus, exposed independently of its definition. -/
   149	theorem picRankOneOpen_map_mem {T T' : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
   150	    (f : T ⟶ T') {lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T}
   151	    (h : lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T) :
   152	    (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map f lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T' :=
   153	  (PicRankOneOpen pi).map f h
   154	
   155	/-- Pullback stability of the public locus, with the base-change direction made explicit. -/
   156	theorem picRankOneOpen_baseChange_mem {T T' : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
   157	    (f : T ⟶ T') {lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T}
   158	    (h : lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T) :
   159	    (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map f lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T' :=
   160	  picRankOneOpen_map_mem pi f h
   161	
   162	/-- The inverse image of `PicRankOneOpen` under the affine widened Abel transformation.
   163	
   164	This name deliberately records only a presentation-theoretic preimage.  It is not the future
   165	open subscheme `DivRankOneOpen`. -/
   166	def divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff :
   167	    Subfunctor (divFunctorAff C (genus C)) :=
   168	  (PicRankOneOpen pi).preimage (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C))
   169	
   170	/-- The same presentation preimage on the Yoneda functor of the canonical genus divisor
   171	representer. -/
   172	def divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter :
   173	    Subfunctor (yoneda.obj (divRepAffGenusScheme C)) :=
   174	  (divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff pi).preimage
   175	    (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).toIso.hom
   176	
   177	/-- The affine Abel transformation restricted to the rank-one presentation preimage. -/
   178	def rankOneAbelAff :
   179	    (divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff pi).toFunctor ⟶
   180	      (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor :=
   181	  (PicRankOneOpen pi).fromPreimage (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C))
   182	
   183	/-- Restrict the canonical representation isomorphism to the rank-one presentation preimage. -/
   184	def rankOneRepresenterRestriction :
   185	    (divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter pi).toFunctor ⟶
   186	      (divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff pi).toFunctor :=
   187	  (divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff pi).fromPreimage
   188	    (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).toIso.hom
   189	
   190	/-- The represented genus Abel map restricted to the rank-one presentation preimage. -/
   191	def rankOneAbelRepresented :
   192	    (divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter pi).toFunctor ⟶
   193	      (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor :=
   194	  rankOneRepresenterRestriction pi ≫ rankOneAbelAff pi
   195	
   196	/-- Immediate consumer theorem: the restricted represented Abel map lands in the public locus.
   197	The stronger canonical inverse still needs the family-level divisor/evaluation producer; this
   198	theorem records the exact target API that consumer lanes can use today. -/
   199	theorem rankOneAbelRepresented_mem {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
   200	    (x : (divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter pi).obj T) :
   201	    ((rankOneAbelRepresented pi).app T x :
   202	      (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T) ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T :=
   203	  ((rankOneAbelRepresented pi).app T x).property
   204	
   205	end

     9	/-!

    11	
    12	The genus divisor representer is unconditional, while the rank-one restriction still needs a
    13	family-level open-locus producer.  This file separates those two facts.  The predicate below is
    14	the inverse image of `PicRankOneOpen` along the represented universal Abel map.  A
    15	`DivRankOneOpenData` witness identifies that predicate with the range of one actual open of the
    16	representer; only after that witness is supplied do we define the open subscheme.
    17	
    18	This shape prevents a logical `Subfunctor` from being silently reinterpreted as a scheme.  It also
    19	gives the canonical inverse lane a stable contract: it consumes the witness equality and can use
    20	the resulting open inclusion and all of its pullbacks without choosing a generator.
    21	-/
    22	
    23	set_option autoImplicit false
    24	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    25	
    26	universe u
    27	
    28	open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite
    29	
    30	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    31	
    32	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    33	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    34	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    35	variable (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi]
    36	
    37	noncomputable section
    38	
    39	/-- The universal genus-divisor predicate whose Abel class lies in `PicRankOneOpen`. -/
    40	def divRankOneUniversalPredicate :
    41	    Subfunctor (yoneda.obj (divRepAffGenusScheme C)) :=
    42	  divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter pi
    43	
    44	/-- The Yoneda map induced by the inclusion of an open of an object in the slice.  Naming this
    45	map is useful to consumers which need the actual factorisation through the open, rather than only
    46	the proposition that a point lies in its range. -/
    47	def openSubfunctorMap (D : Over (Spec (.of k))) (U : D.left.Opens) :
    48	    yoneda.obj (Over.mk (U.ι ≫ D.hom)) ⟶ yoneda.obj D :=
    49	  yoneda.map (Over.homMk (U := Over.mk (U.ι ≫ D.hom)) U.ι)
    50	
    51	/-- The subfunctor represented by an open `U` of an object `D` in the slice over `Spec k`.
    52	
    53	Its values are precisely morphisms which factor through the open immersion `U.ι`; using the
    54	Yoneda range keeps this definition independent of any chosen affine presentation of `U`. -/
    55	def openSubfunctor (D : Over (Spec (.of k))) (U : D.left.Opens) :
    56	    Subfunctor (yoneda.obj D) :=
    57	  Subfunctor.range (openSubfunctorMap D U)
    58	
    59	/-- Unpack range membership into the actual source point and its equality in the ambient Yoneda
    60	functor.  This is the pointwise factorisation API used by inverse constructions. -/
    61	theorem openSubfunctor_mem_iff
    62	    (D : Over (Spec (.of k))) (U : D.left.Opens)
    63	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
    64	    (x : (yoneda.obj D).obj T) :
    65	    x ∈ (openSubfunctor D U).obj T ↔
    66	      ∃ y : (yoneda.obj (Over.mk (U.ι ≫ D.hom))).obj T,
    67	        (openSubfunctorMap D U).app T y = x := by
    68	  rfl
    69	
    70	/-- An explicit geometric certificate for the universal rank-one predicate.
    71	
    72	The equality is the missing family-level producer/gluing statement: it identifies the logical
    73	preimage with an actual open of the canonical genus representer.  No default or top-open witness
    74	is manufactured here. -/
    75	structure DivRankOneOpenData (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi] where
    76	  carrier : (divRepAffGenusScheme C).left.Opens
    77	  carrier_eq :
    78	    openSubfunctor (divRepAffGenusScheme C) carrier =
    79	      divRankOneUniversalPredicate pi
    80	
    81	/-- The open subscheme supplied by a `DivRankOneOpenData` witness. -/
    82	def DivRankOneOpen (h : DivRankOneOpenData (C := C) pi) : Scheme :=
    83	  h.carrier.toScheme
    84	
    85	/-- The canonical open immersion into the genus divisor representer. -/
    86	def divRankOneOpenMap (h : DivRankOneOpenData (C := C) pi) :
    87	    DivRankOneOpen pi h ⟶ (divRepAffGenusScheme C).left :=
    88	  h.carrier.ι
    89	
    90	theorem divRankOneOpen_isOpenImmersion
    91	    (h : DivRankOneOpenData (C := C) pi) :
    92	    IsOpenImmersion (divRankOneOpenMap pi h) := by
    93	  change IsOpenImmersion h.carrier.ι
    94	  infer_instance
    95	
    96	/-- The open represented object, retained in the slice over `Spec k` for consumers of the affine
    97	divisor functor. -/
    98	def divRankOneOpenOver (h : DivRankOneOpenData (C := C) pi) :
    99	    Over (Spec (.of k)) :=
   100	  Over.mk (divRankOneOpenMap pi h ≫ (divRepAffGenusScheme C).hom)
   101	
   102	/-- The inclusion of the certified open, as a morphism in the slice over `Spec k`.
   103	
   104	This is the map whose Yoneda action is consumed by the canonical rank-one Abel inverse.  Naming
   105	it separately keeps consumers independent of the implementation spelling of `divRankOneOpenOver`.
   106	-/
   107	def divRankOneOpenOverMap (h : DivRankOneOpenData (C := C) pi) :
   108	    divRankOneOpenOver pi h ⟶ divRepAffGenusScheme C :=
   109	  Over.homMk (divRankOneOpenMap pi h)
   110	
   111	/-- Pull back the certified rank-one open along an arbitrary slice morphism. -/
   112	def divRankOneOpenPullback
   113	    (h : DivRankOneOpenData (C := C) pi)
   114	    {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (q : T ⟶ divRepAffGenusScheme C) : T.left.Opens :=
   115	  q.left ⁻¹ᵁ h.carrier
   116	
   117	theorem divRankOneOpenPullback_isOpenImmersion
   118	    (h : DivRankOneOpenData (C := C) pi)
   119	    {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (q : T ⟶ divRepAffGenusScheme C) :
   120	    IsOpenImmersion (divRankOneOpenPullback pi h q).ι := by
   121	  infer_instance
   122	
   123	/-- Pointwise form of arbitrary base-change compatibility for the certified open. -/
   124	theorem mem_divRankOneOpenPullback_iff
   125	    (h : DivRankOneOpenData (C := C) pi)
   126	    {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (q : T ⟶ divRepAffGenusScheme C)
   127	    (x : T.left) :
   128	    x ∈ divRankOneOpenPullback pi h q ↔ q.left.base x ∈ h.carrier := by
   129	  rfl

   131	/-- The universal predicate is exactly the represented preimage used by the Abel restriction. -/
   132	theorem divRankOneUniversalPredicate_eq_preimage :
   133	    divRankOneUniversalPredicate pi = divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter pi :=
   134	  rfl
   135	
   136	/-- The certified open carrier has the universal rank-one predicate as its Yoneda range. -/
   137	theorem divRankOneOpen_carrier_eq
   138	    (h : DivRankOneOpenData (C := C) pi) :
   139	    openSubfunctor (divRepAffGenusScheme C) h.carrier =
   140	      divRankOneUniversalPredicate pi :=
   141	  h.carrier_eq
   142	
   143	/-- Pointwise form of the witness equality, exposing the exact contract consumed by an inverse.
   144	
   145	The right-hand side is the range of the open immersion, so a consumer can use this theorem to
   146	replace a rank-one predicate proof by a factorisation through `DivRankOneOpen pi h`. -/
   147	theorem divRankOneOpen_mem_iff
   148	    (h : DivRankOneOpenData (C := C) pi)
   149	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
   150	    (x : (yoneda.obj (divRepAffGenusScheme C)).obj T) :
   151	    x ∈ (divRankOneUniversalPredicate pi).obj T ↔
   152	      x ∈ (openSubfunctor (divRepAffGenusScheme C) h.carrier).obj T := by
   153	  rw [h.carrier_eq]
   154	
   155	/-- A point of the universal rank-one predicate factors through the certified open immersion.
   156	
   157	Unlike a bare range-membership proof, the conclusion exposes the source point and the equality
   158	of its image with the given divisor point, which is the exact data needed by a canonical inverse. -/
   159	theorem divRankOneOpen_mem_iff_factorization
   160	    (h : DivRankOneOpenData (C := C) pi)
   161	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
   162	    (x : (yoneda.obj (divRepAffGenusScheme C)).obj T) :
   163	    x ∈ (divRankOneUniversalPredicate pi).obj T ↔
   164	      ∃ y : (yoneda.obj (Over.mk
   165	          (h.carrier.ι ≫ (divRepAffGenusScheme C).hom))).obj T,
   166	        (openSubfunctorMap (divRepAffGenusScheme C) h.carrier).app T y = x := by
   167	  rw [divRankOneOpen_mem_iff pi h x, openSubfunctor_mem_iff]
   168	
   169	/-- The same factorisation contract with the named open object and slice inclusion.
   170	
   171	The source in the preceding theorem is definitionally the slice object
   172	`divRankOneOpenOver pi h`; this corollary gives the stable public names expected by inverse
   173	consumers. -/
   174	theorem divRankOneOpen_mem_iff_factorization_over
   175	    (h : DivRankOneOpenData (C := C) pi)
   176	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
   177	    (x : (yoneda.obj (divRepAffGenusScheme C)).obj T) :
   178	    x ∈ (divRankOneUniversalPredicate pi).obj T ↔
   179	      ∃ y : (yoneda.obj (divRankOneOpenOver pi h)).obj T,
   180	        (yoneda.map (divRankOneOpenOverMap pi h)).app T y = x := by
   181	  rw [divRankOneOpen_mem_iff_factorization pi h x]
   182	  rfl
   183	
   184	/-- A point in the certified open carrier is a point of the universal rank-one predicate. -/
   185	theorem divRankOneOpen_mem_of_carrier
   186	    (h : DivRankOneOpenData (C := C) pi)
   187	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
   188	    {x : (yoneda.obj (divRepAffGenusScheme C)).obj T}
   189	    (hx : x ∈ (openSubfunctor (divRepAffGenusScheme C) h.carrier).obj T) :
   190	    x ∈ (divRankOneUniversalPredicate pi).obj T := by
   191	  exact (divRankOneOpen_mem_iff pi h x).mpr hx
   192	
   193	/- The logical rank-one predicate remains stable under arbitrary pullback, independently of the
   194	   geometric witness used to represent it by an open. -/
   195	theorem divRankOneOpen_baseChange_mem
   196	    {T T' : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
   197	    (f : T ⟶ T')
   198	    {x : (yoneda.obj (divRepAffGenusScheme C)).obj T}
   199	    (hx : x ∈ (divRankOneUniversalPredicate pi).obj T) :
   200	    (yoneda.obj (divRepAffGenusScheme C)).map f x ∈
   201	      (divRankOneUniversalPredicate pi).obj T' :=
   202	  (divRankOneUniversalPredicate pi).map f hx
